description: Get the connected person's own Fabrica account on Sepolia Testnet: their email, their linked accounts (every wallet address on the account, each listed once), their verification status, the dollars (USDC) each account holds with a Cash out link on fabrica.land from a dollar up, and what this connection may read (its scopes and when its access token expires). Takes no input: it always answers for the person who connected, never for anyone else.
name: get_my_account
title: Get my Fabrica account
